pilot_briefs.learning_goal: Differentiate visible task activity from meaningful organizational progress
pilot_briefs.story: An individual professional late Friday sees completed routine tasks but an untouched priority project; does not introduce a solution
pilot_briefs.visual_direction: Single believable late-Friday work environment; manuscript-accurate work-versus-progress tension; premium photorealism and text-free art; no boardroom group, AI dashboard or false quantitative claims
pilot_briefs.provisional_layout: 04-panel; F01 primary + F03 secondary; operator approved for calibration

pilot_briefs.learning_goal: Dispatch changes to exactly one authorized slide layer while preserving protected components
pilot_briefs.story: A precise operations console routes a revision request to CAD, art, story, or text with clear approval and protection boundaries
pilot_briefs.visual_direction: Professional operator workstation, realistic screens, original technical isometric overlays, source-to-layer routing diagram as independently editable production geometry

pilot_briefs.learning_goal: Diagnose structural, editorial, visual, and export failures independently
pilot_briefs.story: A magazine-grade prepress inspection station compares correct and defective vector/PDF outputs, legibility, and mismatched visual storytelling
pilot_briefs.visual_direction: Realistic print-production quality-control scene with crisp technical insets, not a flat Python diagnostic chart
